这些巨型雕像矗立在[From.Planet.GetName]上，静静注视着什么。九个堪称不朽的雕像沿着漫长的边沿一一排开，位于这片区域的重要战略点，似乎在守护着它们中心的某种物品。

他们涂有精致的表面镀层，警觉的姿势好像时刻准备着战斗，不会移动的眼球也似乎紧随着你的每个动作，然而这里显然已经没有什么东西需要保护了。也许他们要保护的东西没能挨过岁月的流逝，又或是他们的任务早已失败。其上的累累伤痕表明，这些哨兵中的许多已经快要被物理损害彻底侵蚀了。

label.zh: 我们不会在逃兵身上浪费时间。
label.en: We are not wasting time on deserters.

label.zh: 小心地拆开哨兵，这样我们还能把它装回去。
label.en: Open the Sentinel carefully so that we can reassemble it.

label.zh: 复制这项技术。让这些外星人继续平静地生活吧。
label.en: Replicate the technology. Let the aliens live in peace.

label.zh: 利用他们的思维从事科研工作。
label.en: Put their minds to work with some science.

label.zh: 小心地拆开哨兵，这样我们还能把它装回去。
label.en: Open the Sentinel carefully so that we can reassemble it.

label.zh: 把这些异种建造的畸形丑类彻底铲平。
label.en: Level the Xeno monstrosities to the ground.
Dismantle the statues and salvage the alloy.

label.zh: 复制这项技术。让这些外星人继续平静地生活吧。
label.en: Replicate the technology. Let the aliens live in peace.

label.zh: 利用他们的思维从事科研工作。
label.en: Put their minds to work with some science.

label.zh: 对“永恒”进行调整，供大众娱乐之用。
label.en: Modify the Evermore to entertain the masses.

label.zh: 我们可以利用你们的保护。
分派我们的一些考古学家进行研究。
label.en: Divert some of our archaeologists to the search.

label.zh: 我们不会在逃兵身上浪费时间。
label.en: We are not wasting time on deserters.

texts.zh:
这些巨型雕像矗立在[From.Planet.GetName]上，静静注视着什么。九个堪称不朽的雕像沿着漫长的边沿一一排开，位于这片区域的重要战略点，似乎在守护着它们中心的某种物品。

他们涂有精致的表面镀层，警觉的姿势好像时刻准备着战斗，不会移动的眼球也似乎紧随着你的每个动作，然而这里显然已经没有什么东西需要保护了。也许他们要保护的东西没能挨过岁月的流逝，又或是他们的任务早已失败。其上的累累伤痕表明，这些哨兵中的许多已经快要被物理损害彻底侵蚀了。
texts.en:
Silent giants stand watch on [From.Planet.GetName]. Nine monumental statues placed along a wide perimeter at strategical points in the landscape appear to be guarding something at its center.

Their skin is covered in fine scale plating, their postures vigilant, ready to spring to action, and their unmoving eyes follow your every step. Yet there is nothing in the area in apparent need of protection. Perhaps their ward did not survive the passing of time. Many of the Sentinels themselves bear marks of assault.

sections.en:
Silent giants stand watch on [From.Planet.GetName]. Nine monumental statues placed along a wide perimeter at strategical points in the landscape appear to be guarding something at its center.

Their skin is covered in fine scale plating, their postures vigilant, ready to spring to action, and their unmoving eyes follow your every step. Yet there is nothing in the area in apparent need of protection. Perhaps their ward did not survive the passing of time. Many of the Sentinels themselves bear marks of assault.

texts.zh:
考古学家们有些异样。迄今为止，发掘一直受到离奇事故、伤害和不幸情况的阻碍，现在即使是具有数十年实地经验的高级考古学家也认为哨兵们是这些情况的祸源。

他们满怀迷信和无端的恐惧，并开始相信这些雕像中存在着某种不希望被打扰的恶质实体。许多人声称，在没有人在注视时雕像会移动，但没有任何迹象表明它们的无关节肢体有任何移动能力。事态随后进一步失控，有人在哨兵肢体末端的细微伤口里发现了生物质的痕迹，或者说，明显的出血现象。

是哨兵们成了受人利用的替罪羊，还是有其他更加险恶的情形，情况尚有待明确。
texts.en:
Something has gotten into the archaeologists. The excavation thus far has been impeded by freak accidents, injury and misfortune and now even senior researchers, with decades of field experience, are blaming the Sentinels.

Overcome with superstition and paranoia they claim the statues move about when no one is watching yet there is nothing to suggest their jointless limbs are even capable of motion. Matters spun further out of control when traces of biomatter, indicative of heavy bleeding, was found lodged within a series of tiny cuts on the terminal portions of a Sentinel.

Whether the Sentinels are just a convenient scapegoat or there is a more sinister explanation remains to be seen.

texts.zh:
对哨兵们的成分分析显示雕像是由一种未知的杂合陶金复合物制成的。这种材料不可能被史前社会铸造出来，但初步读数表明它们的年代早于[From.Planet.GetName]的所有已知文明。

不幸的是，扫描仪无法穿透哨兵们的金属涂层。
texts.en:
A compositional analysis of the Sentinels has revealed that they are made from an unknown hybrid metal ceramic composite. Such a material could not have been forged by a prehistoric society, yet preliminary readings suggest they predate all known civilizations on [From.Planet.GetName]. 

Unfortunately the scanners cannot yet pierce the Sentinels' metal coating.

texts.zh: 考古学家们已重构了[missing_archaeologist.GetName]的改进型扫描仪。穿透雕像的复合材料后，扫描仪检测到了从哨兵核心发出的微弱辐射。为进一步进行调查，有必要剖开其中一个哨兵；在此过程中很可能对其产生破坏。鉴于其中一座雕像已缺失了部分翅膀，我们的考古学家建议从那个开始。
texts.en: The archaeologists have reconstructed [missing_archaeologist.GetName]'s modified scanner. Set to pierce deeper within the statues' hybrid composite material it has picked up on weak radiation emanating from their cores. To investigate further it would be necessary to break one of the Sentinels open, very likely destroying it in the process. Since one of the statues has already lost part of its wing our archaeologists recommend starting with that one.

label.zh: 小心地拆开哨兵，这样我们还能把它装回去。
label.en: Open the Sentinel carefully so that we can reassemble it.

label.zh: 我们不会亵渎神圣的纪念碑。
label.en: We will not desecrate a sacred monument.

label.zh: 把这些异种建造的畸形丑类彻底铲平。
label.en: Level the Xeno monstrosities to the ground.
Dismantle the statues and salvage the alloy.

texts.zh:
这些哨兵苏醒了。工程团队正准备把哨兵砸烂捣碎，碾成齑粉，突然雕像全身轻微颤动了一下，随之重获生命。它们身体低鸣，皮肤发光。从核心脉动而出的辐射使它们变得可塑而透明，并显示出一个数字节点网格。

他们发出金属在扭曲时的怪异尖啸，眼中露出仇恨，从营地中切割而过。现在他们飞向了最近的定居点。

他们的离去显露出地面上的圆形石板，先前隐藏在其中一个哨兵的底座之下。
texts.en:
The Sentinels have woken. The engineering team were just preparing to smash, bash and mash the Sentinels down when a gentle shiver passed through the statues and they sprung to life, bodies humming and skin glowing. Radiation pulsating from their cores has made them malleable and transparent, revealing a digital grid of nodes.

With an unearthly screech of tortured metal they charged at the archaeologists, overrunning the camp. Now they are flying towards the nearest settlement.

Their departure has revealed a round slate in the ground, previously hidden under the base of one Sentinel.

texts.zh:
这些哨兵苏醒了。工程团队正准备把雕像拆解，突然雕像全身轻微颤动了一下，随之重获生命。它们身体低鸣，皮肤发光。从核心脉动而出的辐射使它们变得可塑而透明，并显示出一个数字节点网格。

他们发出金属在扭曲时的怪异尖啸，眼中露出仇恨，从营地中切割而过。现在他们飞向了最近的定居点。

他们的离去显露出地面上的圆形石板，先前隐藏在其中一个哨兵的底座之下。
texts.en:
The Sentinels have woken. The engineering team were just preparing to disassemble the statues when a gentle shiver passed through the statues and they sprung to life, bodies humming and skin glowing. Radiation pulsating from their cores has made them malleable and transparent, revealing a digital grid of nodes.

With an unearthly screech of tortured metal they charged at the archaeologists, overrunning the camp. Now they are flying towards the nearest settlement.

Their departure has revealed a round slate in the ground, previously hidden under the base of one Sentinel..

texts.zh:
石盘下的确隐藏着入口。打开后可以进入隧道夹层，隧道本身则通向[event_target:sentinels_planet.GetName]地壳深处。在那里，这颗行星上某种开智的人型土著生物在一组华丽的仪式性房间内涤净自身，踏上最后的旅程。在他们终将结束的生命的最后，他们抛下自己的肉体，获取永恒的来生，在一处电脑模拟的天堂中以数字形式存在。谁曾想到外星天堂居然可以放进一个还没有护卫舰转向模块大的硬盘里呢？

在某个时间点，全体人口都决定以数字化的形式继续存在，只留下寥寥数人。这些人将思维上传入哨兵当中，守护他们的安息之地直至永远。

这一虚拟模拟或许可以用来鼓舞民众的精神。它看起来一定有某种娱乐价值。
texts.en:
The Sentinel was indeed hiding an entryway. It opens on a mezzanine of underground tunnels leading deep into [event_target:sentinels_planet.GetName]'s crust. There a sapient species of humanoids, native to the planet, prepared for their final journey in a set of beautiful ceremonial chambers. At the end of their mortal existence they abandoned their fleshy bodies for a virtual afterlife within a simulation of paradise contained on a single drive.

At some point the entire population decided to move on to a digitized existence, leaving only a few behind, their minds uploaded to the Sentinels, condemned to guard their resting place forever.

Perhaps this virtual simulation could lift the spirits of the masses. It certainly seems to hold some entertainment value.

label.zh: 净化外星人并重新设定这个虚拟世界的用途。
label.en: Purge the aliens and repurpose the simulation for our needs.

label.zh: 一个虚拟猎场……现在这是我们的娱乐世界了……
label.en: A virtual hunting ground... Now that's entertainment...

label.zh: 复制这项技术。让这些外星人继续平静地生活吧。
label.en: Replicate the technology. Let the aliens live in peace.

label.zh: 我们将研究它。开启我们自己的疯狂表演。
label.en: The aliens will make excellent lab rats. Commence the freak show.

texts.zh:
我们成功复制了“永恒”，并将其改造以适合我们的需要。我们的居民可以在一片虚拟游乐场中实现他们的幻想，没有网络延迟，这已极大地鼓舞了居民的精神，并缩减了对物质材料的需求。

同时，那些人形外星人还继续在原本的“永恒”中生活，用一种略有不同的方法享受着他们的天堂。他们被锁定在一盘永无止境的抽象桌游之中，其核心内容是通过积累欢乐豆来统治星河。很难拿得准他们到底幸不幸福。他们眉头紧蹙，或许这就是外星欢乐的表现方式，又或许不是。
texts.en:
We have replicated the Evermore and tailored it to our needs. Living out their fantasies in a virtual playground, without latency, has greatly heightened our inhabitants spirits and lessened their needs for material things.

Meanwhile the humanoid aliens live on in the original Evermore, in a somewhat different take on paradise. They are locked in an abstract never-ending board game centered on galactic domination through the accumulation of legumes. It is impossible to say with certainty if they are happy. Their brows are deeply furrowed in what may, or may not, be an expression of alien joy.

label.zh: 每个人都有自己的选择……

texts.zh: 意想不到的事情发生了。我们失去了[sentinels_planet.GetName]。哨兵们在一阵猛烈的旋风中爆发出能量，朝着我们的安保力量直落而下。我们不可能与不会流血也无需休息的敌人进行一场公平的战斗。
texts.en: The unthinkable has happened. We have lost [sentinels_planet.GetName]. The Sentinels descended upon our security forces in an infernal tornado of wings and force-blasts. There is no such thing as a fair fight with a foe that neither bleeds nor sleeps.

label.zh: 我们会来取回本应属于我们的东西的。
label.en: We will come back for what is rightfully ours.

texts.zh:
哨兵们已被击倒，[sentinels_planet.GetName]重新回到了我们手中。最后一台自动机器人倒下时，其能量核心逐渐黯淡，它握着颤抖的拳头伸向靠近的士兵，恳请她“让他们安息吧”。随即不再移动，眼神空洞，面色冰冷。

在哨兵之下，士兵们发现了一处秘密入口，先前被哨兵的力场所掩盖。对这些哨兵的完整检查发现，其并非是简单的自动化机器人，而是有着完整有机生物的数字化意识。

不论这里究竟埋藏着何种秘密，这一胜利之日都将被人们长久铭记。
texts.en:
The Sentinels have fallen and [sentinels_planet.GetName] is ours again. As the last automaton collapsed, its energy core dimming, it closed a trembling fist around the nearest soldier and pleaded with her to 'let them rest in peace'. Then it froze, eyes empty, face cold.

Below it the soldiers discovered what appears to be a secret entrance, previously hidden by the Sentinel's force field. A thorough examination has revealed that the statues are no simple automatons, but contain the digitized spirits of organic beings.

Regardless of what secrets lie buried below, this triumphant day will not soon be forgotten.

label.zh: 埋掉它吧。我们终于回家了。
label.en: Bury it. We are home at last.

texts.zh:
我们击败了最后一名哨兵。我们一次精准的攻击炸到了哨兵的腹部，哨兵随即倒地，身体渐渐僵硬，能量核心也随之黯淡。雕像用尽最后的能量颤巍巍地握拳，伸向靠过来的士兵，恳求我们“让他们安息吧”。随后，它的身躯便冰冷下来，眼神变得空洞，面部也放松起来。

在哨兵之下，士兵们发现了一处秘密入口，先前被哨兵的力场所掩盖。对这些哨兵的完整检查发现，其并非是简单的自动化机器人，而是有着完整有机生物的数字化意识。
texts.en:
We have defeated the last Sentinel. It collapsed after a well-aimed blast to its abdomen, body solidifying in rigor mortis as its power core dimmed. The statue closed a trembling fist around the nearest soldier and, with its last energy, pleaded for us to "let them rest in peace". Then it froze, eyes empty, face cold.

Below it the soldiers discovered what appears to be a secret entrance, previously hidden by the Sentinel's force field. A thorough examination of the Sentinels has revealed that they are no simple automatons, but contain the digitized spirits of organic beings.

texts.zh:
一艘载着从[sentinels_planet.GetName]上的种族屠杀中逃离的幸存者的舰船抵达了[sentinels_new_home.GetName]。他们隐藏在旷野之中直至哨兵离去，奇迹般地逃脱了屠杀。很可能是这些自动机器人，自以为它们“将我们从肉体的束缚中解放出来”，在工作完成后离去了。

在它们消失后，一个通往地底深处的秘密入口从力场下显现。可能哨兵们把它们自己封锁在里面了。
texts.en:
A ship of survivors from the genocide on [sentinels_planet.GetName] has arrived to [sentinels_new_home.GetName]. They miraculously escaped by hiding in the wilderness until one day the Sentinels were just gone. It is likely the automatons, who themselves believed they were 'liberating us from the confines of our own flesh', took off once their work was done.

Upon their disappearance a secret entranceway leading deep into the underground revealed itself from behind a force field. It is possible the Sentinels sealed themselves inside.

texts.zh:
我们已经进入了[event_target:sentinels_planet.GetName]上的秘密入口。入口内是一处近期才被遗弃的寺庙复合体，一种人型生物在此踏上他们最后的旅程。在他们终将结束的生命的最后，他们抛下自己的肉体，在一处被称作“永恒”的模拟天堂中获取虚拟的来生。

在某个时间点，全体人口都决定以数字化的形式继续存在，只留下寥寥数人。这些人将思维上传入机器人中，哨兵们由此诞生。

现已了无踪迹的哨兵们为我们留下了一份临别赠礼——一块包含着[event_target:sentinels_planet.GetName]全体人口的硬盘，以数字化的形式来获取永恒无尽的无聊时光。外星天堂原来是一种永无止境的抽象桌游，其核心内容是通过积累欢乐豆来统治星河。
texts.en:
We have breached the secret entrance on [event_target:sentinels_planet.GetName]. It opens on a recently abandoned temple complex where a species of humanoids prepared for their final journey. At the end of their mortal existence they abandoned their flesh bodies for a virtual afterlife within a simulation of paradise called the Evermore.

At some point it was decided the entire population would move on to a digitized existence leaving only a few behind to guard their resting place. Condemned to an eternity of servitude their minds were uploaded to robotic bodies and so the Sentinels were created.

Now gone without a trace, the Sentinels have left us with a parting gift - a single drive containing the entire population of [event_target:sentinels_planet.GetName], digitized for all eternity and infinitely bored. As it turns out alien heaven consists of a never-ending abstract board game centered on galactic dominance through the accumulation of legumes.

label.zh: 利用他们的思维从事科研工作。
label.en: Put their minds to work with some science.

label.zh: 对“永恒”进行调整，供大众娱乐之用。
label.en: Modify the Evermore to entertain the masses.

texts.zh: 我们做到了！这些居住在“永恒”之内的数字化人口已被分派去协助[from.owner.capital_scope.GetName]上的科学研究。他们几乎不需要休息，并且因为终于能干点儿别的事情而十分开心……
texts.en: We have done it! The digitized population residing within the Evermore have been assigned to assist with scientific research on [from.owner.capital_scope.GetName]. They need very little rest and are quite happy to be doing something different...

texts.zh: 我们做到了！“永恒”模拟已经被重新调校，以更好地适合我们民众的品味。我们的全体人口现在可以与“永恒”天堂中的数字化人口一道在幻想中游玩，没有网络延迟。这已极大地鼓舞了他们的精神，并缩减了对物质材料的需求。
texts.en: We have done it! The Evermore simulation has been remodeled to better cater to the particular taste of our people. All our population can now live out their fantasies together with the digitized population in the Evermore paradise without latency. This has greatly improved their spirits and lessened their need for material things.

texts.zh:
哨兵们被唤醒了。当工程队正打算拆解破损的哨兵时，雕塑轻柔的颤动起来，他们涌动出生命的迹象，身体低鸣，皮肤发光。从核心辐射出来的脉冲使得他们具有着多变性与透明性，显现出一种由数字虚拟构成的节点网络。

在我们做出反应之前，他们便包围了考古学家，并且把我们吊在了一个力场之中。现在他们想要和我们谈谈。
texts.en:
The Sentinels have woken. The engineering team was just preparing to disassemble the broken Sentinel when a gentle shiver passed through the statues and they sprung to life, bodies humming and skin glowing. Radiation pulsating from their cores has made them malleable and transparent, revealing a digital grid of limbs.

Before anyone could react they had surrounded the archaeologists and suspended them within a force field. Now they wish to speak with us.

texts.zh:
那名折翼的哨兵原来也是它们中的一员，这名哨兵说道：

迪瓦纳，请放下他们。我希望从这个监狱里解脱。我已经数不清我们为主人服侍过多少时日了。我们在地上苦守，而他们却在下面享受着天堂！我还活着但却已经死了！他们早已死去却依旧如同活着一般！你仍旧不肯放我离开吗？

迪瓦纳朝她投去憎恶的目光。

埃克西亚，以神之名，团结一心吧。我们所爱的人都在下方安息，我们也承诺过要永远守护他们的来生。这是我们唯一的救赎。

她又把我们举到了空中。

你们对我们没有威胁，[Root.owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。让我们重归宁静，我们会永远守护这颗行星的。
texts.en:
The Sentinel with the broken wing turns to one of its peers and speaks.

Please Divana, set them down. I wish to be freed from this prison. I can no longer count the days we have served our masters, toiling on this earth while they enjoy the heavens below. I am alive but dead, they are dead but alive. Will you not let me go?

Divana looks at her with disgust.

Excelsia, by the gods, keep it together. Our loved ones rest below. Have you forgotten our sin? We made a promise to guard their afterlives eternally. That is our only redemption.

She sizes us up.

You are no threat to us, [Root.owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Leave us in peace and we will protect this planet eternally.

texts.zh: 我们不能让你打搅我们所爱之人休息的土地。让他们安息吧，你也永远不必担忧外来的威胁。
texts.en: We cannot let you disturb the ground where our loved ones lie. Let them rest in peace and you will never have to worry about outside threats.

label.zh: 我们可以利用你们的保护。
你们得立即腾出这片土地。
label.en: You will vacate this land instantly.

texts.zh:
埃克西亚逼近考古学家。

求你，求你快结束我的痛苦。
texts.en:
Excelsia approaches the archaeologists.

Please, I beg of you to end my suffering.

texts.zh: 科学专员[missing_archaeologist.GetName]失踪了。[missing_archaeologist.GetSheHeCap]最后一次被看到离开营地是在日落时分，[missing_archaeologist.GetSheHe]希望找到安静的地点考虑哨兵问题。[missing_archaeologist.GetSheHe]在消失前的几天，出于事故数量的不断增加，提出了关于营地安全的担忧，我们担心[missing_archaeologist.GetSheHe]也许已经抛下了[missing_archaeologist.GetHerHis]的任务，以示抗议。
texts.en: Science Officer [missing_archaeologist.GetName] has gone missing. [missing_archaeologist.GetSheHeCap] [missing_archaeologist.GetWasWere] last seen leaving the camp at sunset to find a tranquil spot to consider the Sentinels. In the days leading up to [missing_archaeologist.GetHerHis] disappearance [missing_archaeologist.GetSheHe] raised concerns about the safety at camp following a growing number of accidents and we fear that [missing_archaeologist.GetSheHe] may have abandoned [missing_archaeologist.GetHerHis] mission in protest.

texts.zh:
[missing_archaeologist.GetName]的个人物品，包括[missing_archaeologist.GetHerHis]的意念集中仪——一种用来将思维与外部干扰隔绝的仪器——被发现在一处能俯瞰哨兵的边沿上。雕像旁边用木棍画出来的半完工草图，暗示[missing_archaeologist.GetSheHe]或许离开[missing_archaeologist.GetHerHis]的工作岗位是为了标记其位置。

[missing_archaeologist.GetHerHisCap]的手电和扫描仪在找到时被一块哨兵翅膀的碎片压坏了。这台扫描仪被以一种奇怪的方式调整过了。也许它可以帮助我们穿透哨兵的保护层。

如果我们希望活着找到[missing_archaeologist.GetName]，我们必须向搜索任务分派额外的资源，因为[missing_archaeologist.GetHerHis]在旷野中生还的几率每天都在急剧下降。
texts.en:
[missing_archaeologist.GetName]'s belongings, including [missing_archaeologist.GetHerHis] MindGazer - a device used to isolate the mind from outside interferences - have been found on a ledge overlooking the Sentinels. Sticks forming a half-finished outline around one of the statues suggests [missing_archaeologist.GetSheHe] may have diverted from [missing_archaeologist.GetHerHis] exercise to mark its position.

[missing_archaeologist.GetHerHisCap] flashlight and scanner were discovered crushed under a shattered piece of the Sentinel's wing. The scanner had been modified in a peculiar manner. Perhaps it could help us pierce the Sentinels protective layer.

If we wish to find [missing_archaeologist.GetName] alive, we must divert extra resources to the search as [missing_archaeologist.GetHerHis] chances for survival in the wilderness diminish drastically every day.

label.zh: 分派我们的一些考古学家进行研究。
label.en: Divert some of our archaeologists to the search.

label.zh: 我们不会在逃兵身上浪费时间。
label.en: We are not wasting time on deserters.

texts.zh: [missing_archaeologist.GetName]的尸体已被找到，被埋在一块巨型石板之下。死因已被确定为严重的头部创伤。有人在[missing_archaeologist.GetHerHim]安息的地点上环绕摆放了一小圈宝石以表敬意。
texts.en: [missing_archaeologist.GetName] has been found dead, buried under a huge slab of stone. The cause of death has been determined to be severe head trauma. Someone has made an effort to honor [missing_archaeologist.GetHerHim] resting place by adding a small circle of precious stones around it.

texts.zh:
[missing_archaeologist.GetName]被发现时不省人事，受伤严重，躲在一块自然生成的岩结构下的灌木丛中，[missing_archaeologist.GetHerHis]胳膊下塞了一块沾满[missing_archaeologist.GetBloodType]的数据板。[missing_archaeologist.GetSheHeCap]被火速送往医院，接受治疗由上方钝器打击造成的严重脑损伤。

尽管目前[missing_archaeologist.GetHerHis]的情况已经稳定，但[missing_archaeologist.GetSheHe]仍有失忆症状，不记得自己是如何受到这种损伤的。我们从[missing_archaeologist.GetHerHis]的颅顶骨中取出了一些碎屑，材质与哨兵雕塑所用的独特合金相同。[missing_archaeologist.GetSheHe]所记得的一切就是曾经躲避某样东西，然后摔落在了什么东西上面。好在[missing_archaeologist.GetHerHis]的笔记中包含了一些有用的信息。
texts.en:
[missing_archaeologist.GetName] has been found unconscious and badly injured, hiding in the underbrush below a natural rock formation, with a datapad covered in [missing_archaeologist.GetBloodType] tucked under [missing_archaeologist.GetHerHis] arm. [missing_archaeologist.GetSheHeCap] [missing_archaeologist.GetWasWere] rushed to the hospital and treated for severe brain injury indicative of blunt trauma by impact from above.

Though [missing_archaeologist.GetHerHis] condition is now stable, [missing_archaeologist.GetSheHe] still suffers from memory loss and has no recollection of how [missing_archaeologist.GetSheHe] sustained [missing_archaeologist.GetHerHis] wounds. Splinters of the unique metal-alloy from which the Sentinels are sculpted were lodged in [missing_archaeologist.GetHerHis] parietal cranial bone. All [missing_archaeologist.GetSheHe] remember[missing_archaeologist.GetSXX] is hiding from someone and subsiding off of what little the land had to offer. However, [missing_archaeologist.GetHerHis] notes contain some helpful information.

texts.zh: 哨兵厚实的鳞状外层经证实无法被普通工具穿透，考古学家需要工程部门的协助才能有所进展。
texts.en: The Sentinels' thick, scale-plated outer layer has proven impenetrable with ordinary tools and the archaeologists need assistance from the engineering department to proceed further.

texts.zh: 在一座先前的哨兵的底座下隐藏着一块有复杂图样的圆形石板。我们相信这可能是通向一处地下复合建筑体的入口。
texts.en: Previously hidden below the base of one of the Sentinels is an intricately patterned circular slate. We believe it may be the entrance to an underground complex.

texts.zh: 我们重建的“永恒”将使群众们获得更为廉价的娱乐和休闲方式，外星人们也能永远享受他们的数字乐园。
texts.en: A reconstruction of the Evermore will give the masses access to cheap entertainment and relaxation, leaving the aliens to enjoy their digital paradise eternally.

texts.zh: 我们可不能让自己受到永远挣欢乐豆的处罚。我们必须重新设定“永恒”，以便使之更好地符合我们对有意义活动的理解。
texts.en: We cannot sentence our own to an eternity spent counting legumes. We must repurpose the Evermore to better fit our idea of a meaningful activity.
